idea-plugin.name: MCP Toolbox
idea-plugin.description: Provides secure, project-aware MCP tools for JetBrains IDE automation through a self-contained MCP 2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP endpoint. The tool set manages IntelliJ IDEA Run Configurations and authenticated Git remote operations.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.0

  • Adds project-bound Git repository and remote discovery, fetch, fast-forward/rebase/merge pull, and non-force push tools.
  • Routes Git authentication through the IDE credential and SSH askpass integration.

0.4.0

  • Provides an independent MCP 2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP server.
  • Adds project-token security and Run Configuration exposure controls.
  • Supports automatic project configuration for eight coding agents.
